correctness.rationale: For every n>=3 the signed three-state automaton gives W_n(s) exactly. N^3=I and the all-negative sign sequence yield zeros if n mod 3 is 1 or 2. The unsigned cardinal is F_{n+3}-1, odd if n mod 3 is 0, so all signed sums are nonzero. In class 1 all sums are even; in class 2 the cardinal is divisible by 4 and each one-coordinate marginal is even, so every sum is divisible by 4. The explicit block P^2N fixes the all-ones terminal vector, and its prefix witnesses realize 1,2,4 in all dimensions. Therefore the gcd and nonzero gap coincide and convolution inverse-on-range norms and positive-spectrum condition numbers are exact. Integer FWHT and independent automaton sums verify all masks through n=10 and selected through n=17. No extrapolation is used.

value.rationale: The full family of Boolean groups and the natural pattern-restricted codebook are fixed before any computation. Exact invertibility and the least surviving Fourier multiplier are natural recovery and stability invariants, now classified for all dimensions rather than a finite numerical slice. The theorem completes a genuinely distinct three-letter forbidden-factor symmetry orbit and supplies the exact inverse-on-range norm, not a simple count or a generic automaton identity. Limits: no total singular nullity or general longer-pattern theorem.
